page.layout: One column of verse, set in italic, with a marginal mark on the right beside lines 17 to 19. Running head at the top, page number at top right, gathering signature at the foot right.

p.i: Fortunæ imperio maior, primordia longa Ingreditur vitæ. Nam ceu per corporis artus Quum subiit animus, pigræ vegetátque mouetque Molis onus, fundítque agilem per membra vigore: Quum fugit exanimum jacet immotúmq; cadaver, Nec quicquam est lutea nisi putris fabrica massa: Sic animi Deus est animus, quo si caret, atris Obruitur tenebris, speciéque illusus inani Fallaces rectiq; boniq; amplectitur umbras. Ast ubi divini concepit Numinis haustum, Diffugiunt tenebræ simulachráque vana facessunt, Nudáque se veri facies in luce videndam Exhibet æterna, quam nullo vespere claudit Septa caput furuis nox importuna tenebris. Hunc ergo in portum cælo plaudente receptus Tu licet in placida tranquillus pace quiescas, Non tamen omnino potuit mors invida totum

Tollere Calvinum[?] terris: æterna manebunt Ingenij monumenta tui, & liuoris iniqui Languida paulatim cum flamma resederit, omnes Religio quà pura nit et se fundet in oras Fama tui: ut nuper falso te nomine Clemens, Te Pauli duo, flagitijs & fraude gemelli, Te Juli timuit rabies, te nobilis una Fraterna impietate Pius: sic nominis umbram Ingeniiq; tui effigiem post fata timebit Vana superstitio: quíque olim infede Quirini Triste furens, flammáque minax, ferróque tyrannus

page.notes: Line 6: the abbreviation over "quicquam" is unclear; read as quicquam with doubt. Line 18: "Calvinum" is uncertain because the printed letters look like "Calnínum". Line 21: "nit et" may be printed "nitet". Line 14: "furuis" is kept as printed. The marginal mark beside the bracket at lines 17 to 19 could not be read. Long s is normalised to s.
